contexts.text: Except slightly.
The shade in which were apparent goods and truths. Signified, Explained.
It is called a state of shade when...
The evil and falsity are what cause the shade...
When people see anything in shade... these Spirits keep the mind fixed on the thought of some Thing...

(Heavenly objects) have sometimes appeared to me in the shade of the light of Heaven, which shade is not like the shade of mundane light; for it is light thinning out and weakening from inability to take it in.
The shadow of my beam () = obscure general [perception]. Explained.
Dead = astate of shade or of night, that is, of ignorance.

Representations come forth by discriminations of light and shade... and all shade is from proprium; and from this (and the light from the Lord) are derived all the variegations of light and shade there.
To dwell in the shadow of death () = in ignorance of good and truth.
The things of the light of the world (are like) the shade of night. Man, being in this shade (believes) that his shade is light, and that light is shade. Explained.
What appears in the internal sense, they believe to be of shade.
The illustration of (such things) brings them more into the shade.
So far as they are in shade, they are not in intelligence...
When man dies, he passes from shade into light. Explained.
Colours (there) are from variegations of light and shade.
Shade there, although it appears as shade, is not like shade (here); for shade there is absence of light, consequently lack of intelligence...
Things which enter without affection fall into the shade of the memory...
Corporeal and worldly things... constantly throw shadows on the mind...
It is this lumen which is called the shadow of death. Explained.
These things are only adumbrations.
The valley of the shadow () = lower things, which are relatively in the shade.

If explicated further, these things would fall into shade... For the understanding has its light and shade; and those things fall into its shade which do not coincide with those of which it previously had some notion. AC 4899.
The fallacies of the senses... induce so great a shade on rational and spiritual things...
They appear like shadows which flit about.
The alternations (in Hell) are only variations of the shade and darkness of night.
For all interior things are of shade and darkness to them.
The land shadowing with wings () = the Church which darkens itself through reasonings from scientifics.
They call the knowledges of our Earth shadows.
That it must be restored before there is a state of shade from the delights of external loves. Signified, Explained.
See Set.
For when an Angel or Spirit is in externals, he is also in shade.
When man is in externals... he is in such shade that...
For a shade in the day-time (). Explained.
Further from the interiors, truth is in shade.
The things which man does not love, he sees in the shade.
Elevation even... when truth is in its shade. Signified, Explained.
Something of shade from him appeared in the former place. Explained.
(Such) when let into their interiors, appear to themselves like those who come from shade into light.
The equilibrium... is as between light and shade... The light and shade operate nothing from themselves; but the heat through them... Falsity corresponds to shade... and spiritual shade is falsity.
With these, the truth of the Word is as in the shade of night... If they see its shade, they falsify it.
The shadow of death, etc. are nothing but the states of those in Hell, who are in falsities of evil.
In the shadow of death = the Gentiles, in good works, but not in truths.
They said, We have seen them in a shade of light... We were seen in a shade, because the light of Heaven is a shade to them, and the shade of Hell is light...
The Israelitish worship shadowed forth the internal worship...
Unless both the spiritual and the natural man are illustrated at the same time, the man is as in shade.
Those washings figured and shadowed forth spiritual washings...
Evil Spirits invent shadowy things... and to these attach many other shadowy things, and phantasies...
To be a shade upon thy right hand () = to be a protection against evil and falsity; a shade, here, is a sunshade.
The shadow of a cloud () = a defence from these things. Explained.
Through a land of dense shade () = a state of ignorance of truth and consequent Falsity. ( = the understanding of truth obscured. AE 730:38.)
To live in His shadow () = to be in His protection against the falsities of evil.
The drawing back of the shadow on the steps of Ahaz () = the prolongation of that time. AE 706:16.
The falsity in which these are is called the shadow of death. ().
To walk in a shady valley () = obscure understanding to which do not appear truths from light.
To dwell in the shadow of its branches () = terminated in natural truths; for these cover and guard rational truths...
With these there is as it were a shader between spiritual and natural light; yet with many this shader is transparent.
The defect and absence of (good and truth) correspond to shade (here).
Redeemer. 4. The power of the Highest which should overshadow = the Divine good.
